2608.04047.title: Beyond the QBER Threshold: A Temporal QBER Based Machine Learning Framework for Multi Attack Detection in BB84 QKD
2608.04047.paper_summary: Conventional BB84 Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) systems rely on a fixed 11% Quantum Bit Error Rate (QBER) threshold to detect eavesdropping. However, stealthy attacks can remain below this threshold while still compromising channel security. This paper proposes a temporal QBER based machine learning framework for detecting and classifying eavesdropping attacks in BB84 QKD systems. Rather than relying on average session level QBER, the framework extracts 63 physics-informed temporal features capturing burst behavior, temporal instability, basis dependent asymmetry, and QBER loss interactions. Random Forest, XGBoost, and Support Vector Machine with a Radial Basis Function kernel (SVM-RBF) classifiers are evaluated on seven eavesdropping attacks and a normal channel scenario under noisy and lossy conditions. Averaged over ten independent runs, XGBoost achieves the best performance with 88.01% (0.47%) accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.8803, while SVM-RBF performs comparably, confirming the robustness of the proposed features. Evaluated as a binary attack-versus-normal detector for comparison with conventional monitoring, a fixed 11% QBER threshold achieves only 25.82% accuracy with a False Negative Rate (FNR) of 0.8477, whereas the proposed framework reduces the FNR to 0.0198, substantially improving detection of stealthy attacks that evade threshold-based monitoring. SHapley Additive exPlanations based (SHAP) explainability shows that physics-informed temporal and channel derived features are highly discriminative for identifying eavesdropping strategies. These results demonstrate that temporal QBER driven machine learning provides an accurate, explainable, and practical framework for multi attack security monitoring in BB84 QKD systems.
2608.04047.paper_summary_zh: 傳統的 BB84 量子密鑰分配 (QKD) 系統依賴固定的 11% 量子比特錯誤率 (QBER) 閾值來檢測竊聽。然而，隱蔽攻擊可以保持在此閾值以下，同時仍然危及通道安全。本文提出了一種基於時間 QBER 的機器學習框架，用於檢測和分類 BB84 QKD 系統中的竊聽攻擊。該框架不依賴於平均會話級 QBER，而是提取 63 個物理知識驅動的時間特徵，捕捉突發行為、時間不穩定性、基於依賴的不對稱性和 QBER 損失互動。在七種竊聽攻擊和一種正常通道場景下，隨機森林、XGBoost 和帶有徑向基函數核的支持向量機 (SVM-RBF) 分類器在噪聲和損失條件下進行評估。經過十次獨立運行的平均，XGBoost 以 88.01% (0.47%) 的準確率和 0.8803 的宏 F1 分數達到最佳性能，而 SVM-RBF 的表現相當，確認了所提特徵的穩健性。作為與傳統監控進行比較的二元攻擊與正常檢測器，固定的 11% QBER 閾值僅達到 25.82% 的準確率，且假陰性率 (FNR) 為 0.8477，而所提框架將 FNR 降至 0.0198，顯著改善了對逃避基於閾值監控的隱蔽攻擊的檢測。基於 SHapley 加法解釋 (SHAP) 的可解釋性顯示，物理知識驅動的時間和通道衍生特徵對於識別竊聽策略具有高度區分性。這些結果表明，基於時間 QBER 的機器學習為 BB84 QKD 系統中的多重攻擊安全監控提供了一個準確、可解釋且實用的框架。
